rationale: Base station storage was at 99% with loop recording disabled, producing error E-402 and a solid purple LED (storage >95%). This matches the customer's symptom of the timeline stopping at the end of last month while live view/notifications still worked. After enabling loop recording, a newly triggered event appeared in the timeline with today's timestamp, confirming recording resumed and the fault is resolved.

repair_steps: Confirm with the customer that the purple LED has turned off after enabling loop recording and triggering a new event.
If the purple LED remains on, guide the customer to export any important clips and then format the storage from Base Station Settings > Storage.
After formatting, ask the customer to trigger another event and verify that a new event appears in the timeline and the LED is no longer purple.
If the issue persists or new events do not appear, escalate to FAE with details of the storage state and LED status.
